headline: Area becomes first to clinch a division this season, extending their unbeaten streak to 40 weeks (just 2 from RDL's 5th longest run ever); Ducks top Menace in 1001, making the race for 2nd wide open; Secrets and Mafia post important wins

prediction.text: Match #5: (C Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Darty Little Secrets. Area waltzed away with the C crown, but the other spot in the top pair is very much up for grabs. And this match likely decides it! Menace in 1001?
